answer_1.quote: We evaluate all models, including three different LLMs, on five conditional benchmarks (GSM8K, IFEval, PiQA, MMLU, TruthfulQA) and three open‑ended benchmarks (AlpacaEval2, HH‑RLHF, TL;DR).

answer_2.quote: We report strict exact match score for GSM8K, accuracy for IFEval, PiQA, MMLU, TruthfulQA, and win rate (including length‑debiased win rate) for AlpacaEval2, HH‑RLHF and TL;DR.

answer_3.quote: The version of GPT-4 evaluator is all set as: gpt-4-turbo.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct a large‑scale human evaluation... hired a 30‑person annotation team... scoring criteria are relatively simple, distinguishing only between incorrect and acceptable responses.
answer_4.guideline: Distinguish between incorrect and acceptable responses.
